Release: llm-openrouter 0.7.1

# Simon Willison’s Weblog

Release llm-openrouter 0.7.1 — LLM plugin for models hosted by OpenRouter

- Performance fix for loading OpenRouter models. Thanks, waveplate . #59

Posted 2nd September 2026 at 8:23 pm

summaryZh: llm-openrouter插件发布0.7.1版本，主要修复了加载OpenRouter模型时的性能问题。该更新旨在提升工具链的稳定性。
